premises: Plasma nitriding can introduce a high concentration of nitrogen into the surface of titanium alloys.
The introduced nitrogen will diffuse and react with titanium to form a hard TiN layer.
The formation of a TiN layer increases surface hardness.
The increased surface hardness leads to improved wear resistance.
The bulk properties of the alloy remain largely unchanged after the treatment.
